description.zh: 把一台 ComfyUI(本机或局域网)接成图像 / 视频生成供应商:它里面保存的每张工作流都是一个模型,可调参数和参考图槽位自动识别,进度实时、能真的取消。
description.en: Connect a ComfyUI server (local or on your LAN) as an image / video provider: every saved workflow becomes a model, with its tunable parameters and reference-image slots detected automatically, live progress and real cancellation.

help.zh: 本机默认是 http://127.0.0.1:8188;填局域网地址就能用另一台机器的显卡。多台服务器就建多个连接。
help.en: http://127.0.0.1:8188 on this machine; a LAN address uses another machine's GPU. One connection per server.

help.zh: 认不出的非常规工作流的退路:在 ComfyUI 里「导出 (API)」后粘贴,可用 {{prompt}} {{negative}} {{seed}} {{width}} {{height}} {{steps}} 占位符。它会作为「API 模板」出现在模型列表里。
help.en: A fallback for unusual workflows the converter can't read: use “Export (API)” in ComfyUI and paste it; {{prompt}} {{negative}} {{seed}} {{width}} {{height}} {{steps}} placeholders work. It shows up as “API template” in the model list.

description.zh: 替 Mosael 在这台 ComfyUI 上列出模型、做一次生成。只给宿主调。
description.en: Lists models and runs generations on this ComfyUI server for Mosael. Host-only.
